dataset_section_purpose: Documents the retrieval corpus so Conditions 2-4 are reproducible and comparable with Condition 1.

condition_definitions.implementation: No external retrieval and no ontology-derived context.
Attempts external Chroma vector retrieval; actual context exposure is audited per row.
Attempts external RAG and adds a directly serialized PSQ-SCO semantic packet.

Attempts external Chroma vector retrieval and adds ontology-derived text selected by a deterministic lexical ranker; actual external-context exposure is audited per row, and the ontology-derived records are not embedded by the current implementation.

same_sources_across_conditions: Text-RAG Generation, Ontology-Derived Structured Prompting RAG, and Ontology-to-Text Vector RAG attempt retrieval from the same PSQ_RAG_PROFILE=quality external corpus selection unless explicitly overridden; the evaluator separately reports rows where retrieval returned no external context. Prompt-Only Generation is the no-retrieval baseline.
embedding_model: sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2 (expected Chroma default because rag_engine.py does not pass a custom embedding_function)
embedding_model_status: Expected from the official Chroma default-embedding documentation, not fully provenance-frozen for the historical generation run. The exact Chroma package version, model artifact hash, and embedding-function configuration were not stored in the generation records.
embedding_model_training_domain: General-purpose sentence-pair representation learning, not a cybersecurity-ontology-specific model. The all-MiniLM-L6-v2 model card reports 384-dimensional embeddings, fine-tuning on more than one billion sentence pairs, and truncation beyond 256 word pieces.
embedding_model_domain_mismatch: Because the model is general-purpose, source relevance for phishing/smishing/vishing and verbalized OWL records must be treated as an empirical retrieval question rather than assumed from the model name.
ontology_text_selection: The ontology-derived records are selected by a deterministic lexical relevance score, mandatory document-type coverage, and optional deterministic greedy relation walk. They are not stored in or retrieved from Chroma by the current implementation.

ontology_walk_algorithm.start_nodes: up to five IDs ordered as selected templates, fixed-order validation rules, then evidence sources
ontology_walk_algorithm.depth: walk_depth=2 by default, producing depth 0, 1, and 2 nodes per start when edges exist
ontology_walk_algorithm.edge_score: count of case query terms occurring in property, target ID, target label, target definition, or target types; +1 when target is a known ontology record
ontology_walk_algorithm.tie_break: descending score, then property name ascending, then target ID ascending
ontology_walk_algorithm.transition: choose exactly one highest-ranked outgoing property-target pair at each step
ontology_walk_algorithm.stopping: stop at maximum depth, missing current record, or no outgoing candidate
ontology_walk_algorithm.cycle_policy: no visited-node exclusion in the historical implementation; depth bound guarantees termination
ontology_walk_algorithm.frozen_run_exposure: The evaluated graph-walk variant declared the walk for 1/1 Condition-4 rows and exported an identifiable selected_subgraph_walk context for 1/1. Ontology context delivery is separate from external text-RAG delivery, which occurred for 1/1 rows.

evaluated_generation_profile.interpretation: The evaluated graph-walk variant declared the walk for 1/1 Condition-4 rows and exported an identifiable selected_subgraph_walk context for 1/1. Ontology context delivery is separate from external text-RAG delivery, which occurred for 1/1 rows.

chunking: One JSONL record is converted into one retrieval document by concatenating available text/subject/body/messages/dialogue/cue fields.
preprocessing: JSONL rows with short text are skipped; exact lowercased text hashes are deduplicated; profile caps limit very large corpora.

retrieval_settings.query: role, job title hint, channel, variant, knowledge type, interaction pattern, development focus, age group
retrieval_settings.final_n_results_generation: configured by --n-rag-examples; final paper ontology-text runs use 1 external RAG example
